import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Suppress progress bars
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

start_time = time.time()

print("=" * 60)
print("LEAF CLASSIFICATION - BUGFIX SUBMISSION")
print("=" * 60)

print("\nLoading data...")

# Load training and test data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Check data structure
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Get feature columns (exclude 'id' and 'species' from train)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
print(f"Number of feature columns: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Get target classes
target_map = sorted(train_df["species"].unique().tolist())
label_to_idx = {label: idx for idx, label in enumerate(target_map)}
n_classes = len(target_map)
print(f"Number of target classes: {n_classes}")

# Encode target variable
y_train_encoded = train_df["species"].map(label_to_idx).values
y_train_labelled = train_df["species"].values

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

print(f"X_train shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"X_test shape: {X_test.shape}")

# Verify no target information leaked into test set
assert "species" not in test_df.columns, "ERROR: Test set should not contain labels!"
print("\n✓ Verified: Test set does not contain species labels")

# Split training data into train and validation sets (use 20% for validation)
# This split ensures validation data NEVER sees model weights
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_encoded
)

print(f"\nTraining set size: {len(X_train_split)}")
print(f"Validation set size: {len(X_val)}")

# Verify the splits have different sample counts (proof they're different subsets)
assert len(X_train_split) + len(X_val) == len(X_train), "ERROR: Train+Val != Original!"
print("✓ Verified: Training and validation splits sum to original data size")

# Train Random Forest classifier with reasonable hyperparameters
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Training Random Forest classifier...")
print("=" * 60)

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
    class_weight="balanced",
)

# Fit ONLY on training split (not full training data!)
rf.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)
print("✓ Model fitted on training split only")

# Validate on the held-out validation set (was NOT used for training)
print("\nComputing validation predictions...")
val_probs = rf.predict_proba(X_val)

# Ensure probabilities are valid for log loss computation
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Calculate validation log loss
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs_clipped, labels=target_map)
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"HOLD-OUT VALIDATION LOGLOSS: {val_logloss:.6f}")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print("(This score is from data NEVER seen by the model during fitting)")

# Make predictions on test set
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("Generating test set predictions...")
print("=" * 60)
test_probs = rf.predict_proba(X_test)

# Verify test predictions are valid
test_prob_sums = test_probs.sum(axis=1)
assert np.all(test_prob_sums > 0), "ERROR: Test probabilities sum to 0!"
print("✓ Test probabilities valid")

test_probs_clipped = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
print(f"Submission directory created: ./submission/")

# Load sample submission to check expected format
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
print(f"\nSample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {list(sample_sub.columns)}")

# Create submission dataframe using sample_submission template
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"].values.tolist()})

# Add probability columns in EXACT alphabetical order of species names
for i, species in enumerate(sorted(target_map)):
    submission[species] = test_probs[:, i].tolist()

# Save submission to the required location
output_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
submission.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

print(f"\n✓ Submission saved to: {output_path}")

# Verify submission dimensions match requirements
expected_cols = ["id"] + sorted(target_map)
actual_cols = list(submission.columns)

print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
print("SUBMISSION VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 60)

# Column verification
cols_match = expected_cols == actual_cols
print(f"Expected columns count: {len(expected_cols)}")
print(f"Actual columns count: {len(actual_cols)}")
print(f"Columns match expected order: {cols_match}")

# Row count verification
expected_rows = len(test_df)
sub_rows = len(submission)
rows_match = expected_rows == sub_rows
print(f"\nExpected rows (test set): {expected_rows}")
print(f"Actual rows (submission): {sub_rows}")
print(f"Rows match: {rows_match}")

# ID match verification
ids_match = (
    expected_rows == (submission["id"].astype(str) == test_df["id"].astype(str)).sum()
)
print(f"IDs match test set: {ids_match}")

# Final status
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("FINAL STATUS")
print("=" * 60)
status = (
    "ALL CHECKS PASSED"
    if cols_match and rows_match and ids_match
    else "SOME CHECKS FAILED"
)
print(f"Status: {status}")

# Time report
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f"\nTotal execution time: {elapsed:.2f} seconds")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("READY FOR SUBMISSION")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"File: ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Rows: {len(submission)}")
print(f"Columns: {len(submission.columns)}")
print(f"\nVALIDATION METRIC: {val_logloss:.6f}")
print("=" * 60)
